title: Require edit authorization in page delete tool delegate
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.5. memorysmith_page_delete delegate currently checks visibility semantics instead of edit semantics. Align delegate-level authorization with write operation requirements and add focused authorization tests.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented delegate-level edit authorization for `memorysmith_page_delete` in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatToolCatalog.cs`. The delete tool now enforces edit semantics (`CanEditPage` -> `CanSetPageMinimumRole`) instead of visibility semantics (`CanViewPage`) before delete operations. Added focused regression tests in `MemorySmith.Tests/ChatToolCatalogAndInterceptTests.cs`: `PageDeleteTool_RejectsAnonymousCallerEvenForVisiblePage` and `PageDeleteTool_AllowsEditorToDeleteNonAdminPage`. Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~PageDeleteTool_RejectsAnonymousCallerEvenForVisiblePage|Name~PageDeleteTool_AllowsEditorToDeleteNonAdminPage|Name~McpSafeDefaults_HideSensitiveAndWriteToolsUntilExplicitlyEnabled|Name~McpToolConfig_HidesAndBlocksDisabledTools"` (4/4 passed). Live check: `Invoke-WebRequest https://localhost:7090/health -SkipCertificateCheck` returned `200`.
